description: This script is a Perl-based utility designed for flashing firmware onto a D-Link DSL-G6x4T device. It performs network discovery of the device via UDP broadcast, then uses FTP commands to upload firmware images to specific memory partitions, and finally reboots the device.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with additional methods for interacting with the ADAM2 device, including environment variable retrieval and reboot command.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends a USER command with the specified argument, returns the response.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Sends GETENV command to retrieve environment variable values from device.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to retrieve environment variables from device.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends a REBOOT command to the device.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device.
